The same publication-level thematic representation is used here and in the strategic diagram.

### Three-field plot: authors, keywords, and journals

For author $a$, keyword $k$, and journal $j$,

$$
w_{ak}=\sum_p I(a\in A_p)I(k\in K_p),
$$

and

$$
w_{kj}=\sum_p I(k\in K_p)I(j=J_p).
$$

Global entity frequencies are calculated before complete-case filtering. Cross-field links are then constructed only from publications containing author, keyword, and journal information. Links with at least two supporting publications are displayed.

```{python}
TOP_N_AUTHORS_THREE_FIELD = 5
TOP_N_KEYWORDS_THREE_FIELD = 10
TOP_N_JOURNALS_THREE_FIELD = 7
MIN_THREE_FIELD_EDGE_WEIGHT = 2
MAX_THREE_FIELD_LABEL_LENGTH = 40

three_field_df = add_publication_id(corpus_df)
three_field_df["Authors"] = three_field_df["authors"].apply(clean_unique_strings)
three_field_df["Keywords"] = three_field_df["keywords"].apply(normalize_keywords)
three_field_df["Journal"] = three_field_df["journal_title"].astype("string").str.strip()
three_field_df.loc[three_field_df["Journal"].eq(""), "Journal"] = pd.NA

author_frequency = Counter()
keyword_frequency = Counter()
journal_frequency = Counter()
for row in three_field_df.itertuples(index=False):
    author_frequency.update(set(row.Authors))
    keyword_frequency.update(set(row.Keywords))
    if pd.notna(row.Journal):
        journal_frequency.update([str(row.Journal)])

top_authors_three_field = [
    entity
    for entity, _ in author_frequency.most_common(TOP_N_AUTHORS_THREE_FIELD)
]
top_keywords_three_field = [
    entity
    for entity, _ in keyword_frequency.most_common(TOP_N_KEYWORDS_THREE_FIELD)
]
top_journals_three_field = [
    entity
    for entity, _ in journal_frequency.most_common(TOP_N_JOURNALS_THREE_FIELD)
]

complete_three_field = three_field_df[
    three_field_df["Authors"].apply(bool)
    & three_field_df["Keywords"].apply(bool)
    & three_field_df["Journal"].notna()
].copy()

author_keyword_counter = Counter()
keyword_journal_counter = Counter()
for row in complete_three_field.itertuples(index=False):
    selected_authors = set(row.Authors).intersection(top_authors_three_field)
    selected_keywords = set(row.Keywords).intersection(top_keywords_three_field)
    selected_journal = (
        str(row.Journal)
        if row.Journal in top_journals_three_field
        else None
    )

    for author in selected_authors:
        for keyword in selected_keywords:
            author_keyword_counter[(author, keyword)] += 1

    if selected_journal is not None:
        for keyword in selected_keywords:
            keyword_journal_counter[(keyword, selected_journal)] += 1

author_keyword_edges = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {"Author": author, "Keyword": keyword, "Weight": weight}
        for (author, keyword), weight in author_keyword_counter.items()
        if weight >= MIN_THREE_FIELD_EDGE_WEIGHT
    ]
)
keyword_journal_edges = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {"Keyword": keyword, "Journal": journal, "Weight": weight}
        for (keyword, journal), weight in keyword_journal_counter.items()
        if weight >= MIN_THREE_FIELD_EDGE_WEIGHT
    ]
)

connected_author_keywords = (
    set(author_keyword_edges["Keyword"])
    if not author_keyword_edges.empty
    else set()
)
connected_journal_keywords = (
    set(keyword_journal_edges["Keyword"])
    if not keyword_journal_edges.empty
    else set()
)
connected_keywords = connected_author_keywords.intersection(
    connected_journal_keywords
)

author_keyword_edges = author_keyword_edges[
    author_keyword_edges["Keyword"].isin(connected_keywords)
].copy()
keyword_journal_edges = keyword_journal_edges[
    keyword_journal_edges["Keyword"].isin(connected_keywords)
].copy()

connected_authors = (
    sorted(author_keyword_edges["Author"].unique())
    if not author_keyword_edges.empty
    else []
)
connected_keywords = sorted(connected_keywords)
connected_journals = (
    sorted(keyword_journal_edges["Journal"].unique())
    if not keyword_journal_edges.empty
    else []
)

three_field_rankings = pd.concat(
    [
        pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "Field": "Author",
                "Entity": top_authors_three_field,
                "Global_Document_Frequency": [
                    author_frequency[value] for value in top_authors_three_field
                ],
            }
        ),
        pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "Field": "Keyword",
                "Entity": top_keywords_three_field,
                "Global_Document_Frequency": [
                    keyword_frequency[value] for value in top_keywords_three_field
                ],
            }
        ),
        pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "Field": "Journal",
                "Entity": top_journals_three_field,
                "Global_Document_Frequency": [
                    journal_frequency[value] for value in top_journals_three_field
                ],
            }
        ),
    ],
    ignore_index=True,
)

dataframe_to_csv(
    three_field_rankings,
    "table_three_field_global_rankings.csv",
)
dataframe_to_csv(
    author_keyword_edges,
    "network_three_field_author_keyword_edges.csv",
)
dataframe_to_csv(
    keyword_journal_edges,
    "network_three_field_keyword_journal_edges.csv",
)

author_ids = {value: f"author::{value}" for value in connected_authors}
keyword_ids = {value: f"keyword::{value}" for value in connected_keywords}
journal_ids = {value: f"journal::{value}" for value in connected_journals}
all_ids = (
    list(author_ids.values())
    + list(keyword_ids.values())
    + list(journal_ids.values())
)
node_index = {node_id: index for index, node_id in enumerate(all_ids)}


def short_label(value: str) -> str:
    if len(value) <= MAX_THREE_FIELD_LABEL_LENGTH:
        return value
    return value[: MAX_THREE_FIELD_LABEL_LENGTH - 1] + "…"


node_labels = (
    [short_label(value) for value in connected_authors]
    + [short_label(value) for value in connected_keywords]
    + [short_label(value) for value in connected_journals]
)

sources, targets, values = [], [], []
for row in author_keyword_edges.itertuples(index=False):
    sources.append(node_index[author_ids[row.Author]])
    targets.append(node_index[keyword_ids[row.Keyword]])
    values.append(int(row.Weight))
for row in keyword_journal_edges.itertuples(index=False):
    sources.append(node_index[keyword_ids[row.Keyword]])
    targets.append(node_index[journal_ids[row.Journal]])
    values.append(int(row.Weight))

three_field_figure = go.Figure(
    data=[
        go.Sankey(
            arrangement="snap",
            node=dict(label=node_labels, pad=18, thickness=18),
            link=dict(source=sources, target=targets, value=values),
        )
    ]
)
three_field_figure.update_layout(
    title="Three-Field Plot: Authors – Keywords – Journals",
    font_size=10,
)
save_plotly_html(
    three_field_figure,
    "fig_three_field_authors_keywords_journals.html",
)
try_save_plotly_png(
    three_field_figure,
    "fig_three_field_authors_keywords_journals.jpg",
)
three_field_figure.show()

three_field_summary = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Metric": [
            "Complete-case publications",
            "Connected authors",
            "Connected keywords",
            "Connected journals",
            "Author-keyword edges",
            "Keyword-journal edges",
        ],
        "Value": [
            len(complete_three_field),
            len(connected_authors),
            len(connected_keywords),
            len(connected_journals),
            len(author_keyword_edges),
            len(keyword_journal_edges),
        ],
    }
)
show_interactive_table(three_field_summary)
show_interactive_table(three_field_rankings, paging=True, searching=True, info=True)
show_interactive_table(author_keyword_edges, paging=True, searching=True, info=True)
show_interactive_table(keyword_journal_edges, paging=True, searching=True, info=True)
```

The top entities are selected globally before complete-case filtering, whereas the plotted cross-field links require complete author, keyword, and journal information.
